# Base64 Group (`base64`)

Opt-in library group `base64`. Disabled by default; enable it in the host environment to call `base64.*` functions (see [`spec/packages/f06-groups.md`](../../spec/packages/f06-groups.md)).

| Entry | Signature | Summary |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [`base64.encode`](#base64encode) | `base64.encode(s: string) => string` | The base64 text, with padding, of the UTF-8 encoding of s. |
| [`base64.decode`](#base64decode) | `base64.decode(s: string) => string !` | The text whose UTF-8 encoding a base64 text holds. |

## `base64.encode`

The base64 text, with padding, of the UTF-8 encoding of s.

```text
base64.encode: (s: string) => string
```

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Parameters | `s: string` |
| Returns | `string` |
| Returns null | Never |
| Steps | `sz(s) + sz(result)` |
| Allocation units | `1 + sz(result)` |
| Since | `3.0` |

**Examples**

| Expression | Inputs | Result |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `base64.encode("")` |  | `""` |
| `base64.encode("a")` |  | `"YQ=="` |
| `base64.encode("ab")` |  | `"YWI="` |
| `base64.encode("abc")` |  | `"YWJj"` |
| `base64.encode("é")` |  | `"w6k="` |
| `base64.encode(s)` | `s = "abc"` | `"YWJj"` (1 step, 1 unit) |
| `base64.encode(x)` | `x = null` | Fails: `wrong-kind` — base64.encode cannot take a value of kind null |

## `base64.decode`

The text whose UTF-8 encoding a base64 text holds.

```text
base64.decode: (s: string) => string !
```

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Parameters | `s: string` |
| Returns | `string` (may fail with a value error, `!`) |
| Returns null | Never |
| Steps | `sz(s)` |
| Allocation units | `1 + sz(result)` |
| Since | `3.0` |

**Run-time failures**

| Code | Kind | When |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `invalid-argument` (`not-base64`) | `value` | s is not base64 text of one alphabet with valid padding |
| `invalid-argument` (`not-utf8`) | `value` | the decoded bytes are not well-formed UTF-8 |

**Examples**

| Expression | Inputs | Result |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `base64.decode("YQ==")` |  | `"a"` |
| `base64.decode("YQ")` |  | `"a"` |
| `base64.decode("YWI=")` |  | `"ab"` |
| `base64.decode("YWI")` |  | `"ab"` |
| `base64.decode("YWJj")` |  | `"abc"` |
| `base64.decode(s)` | `s = "YWJj"` | `"abc"` (1 step, 1 unit) |
| `base64.decode("YQ=")` |  | Fails: `invalid-argument` — the text is not valid base64 |
| `base64.decode("gA==")` |  | Fails: `invalid-argument` — the decoded bytes are not valid UTF-8 |
